name: b2bi
description: This is the Amazon Web Services B2B Data Interchange API Reference.

subcommands.name: create-capability
subcommands.description: Instantiates a capability based on the specified parameters.

subcommands.name: create-partnership
subcommands.description: Creates a partnership between a customer and a trading partner, based on the supplied parameters.

subcommands.name: create-profile
subcommands.description: Creates a customer profile.

subcommands.name: create-starter-mapping-template
subcommands.description: Amazon Web Services B2B Data Interchange uses a mapping template in JSONata or XSLT format to transform a customer input file into a JSON or XML file that can be converted to EDI.

subcommands.name: create-transformer
subcommands.description: Creates a transformer.

subcommands.name: delete-capability
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified capability.

subcommands.name: delete-partnership
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified partnership.

subcommands.name: delete-profile
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified profile.

subcommands.name: delete-transformer
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified transformer.

subcommands.name: generate-mapping
subcommands.description: Takes sample input and output documents and uses Amazon Bedrock to generate a mapping automatically.

subcommands.name: get-capability
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details for the specified capability.

subcommands.name: get-partnership
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details for a partnership, based on the partner and profile IDs specified.

subcommands.name: get-profile
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details for the profile specified by the profile ID.

subcommands.name: get-transformer
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details for the transformer specified by the transformer ID.

subcommands.name: get-transformer-job
subcommands.description: Returns the details of the transformer run, based on the Transformer job ID.

subcommands.name: list-capabilities
subcommands.description: Lists the capabilities associated with your Amazon Web Services account for your current or specified region.

subcommands.name: list-partnerships
subcommands.description: Lists the partnerships associated with your Amazon Web Services account for your current or specified region.

subcommands.name: list-profiles
subcommands.description: Lists the profiles associated with your Amazon Web Services account for your current or specified region.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all of the tags associated with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that you specify.

subcommands.name: list-transformers
subcommands.description: Lists the available transformers.

subcommands.name: start-transformer-job
subcommands.description: Runs a job, using a transformer, to parse input EDI (electronic data interchange) file into the output structures used by Amazon Web Services B2B Data Interchange.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Attaches a key-value pair to a resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: test-conversion
subcommands.description: This operation mimics the latter half of a typical Outbound EDI request.

subcommands.name: test-mapping
subcommands.description: Maps the input file according to the provided template file.

subcommands.name: test-parsing
subcommands.description: Parses the input EDI (electronic data interchange) file.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Detaches a key-value pair from the specified resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: update-capability
subcommands.description: Updates some of the parameters for a capability, based on the specified parameters.

subcommands.name: update-partnership
subcommands.description: Updates some of the parameters for a partnership between a customer and trading partner.

subcommands.name: update-profile
subcommands.description: Updates the specified parameters for a profile.

subcommands.name: update-transformer
subcommands.description: Updates the specified parameters for a transformer.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: transformer-job-succeeded
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query status returns succeeded when polling with ``get-transformer-job``.
